subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw accept this external-orchestrator lease protocol as a permanent core Gateway and state-database contract, or require it to use an owner-neutral plugin/SDK seam?
rationale: The answer establishes public RPC names, authorization semantics, persisted recovery data, and maintenance ownership. The repository policy favors plugin-owned optional integrations, so a core exception needs explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Require an owner-neutral seam
options.body: Refactor the named Agentic OS contract into its owner plugin or downstream integration, proposing only the smallest generic core extension that is demonstrably missing.

options.title: Sponsor core ownership
options.body: Explicitly accept the Gateway methods, storage schema, retention semantics, protocol clients, and compatibility burden as permanent core APIs.

recommendation.title: Require an owner-neutral seam
recommendation.body: Refactor the named Agentic OS contract into its owner plugin or downstream integration, proposing only the smallest generic core extension that is demonstrably missing.
